name: 川西竹舍
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: illustrated background artwork for a Chinese hotpot tile-puzzle mobile game. Background only.
Primary request: Create a NEW rich handpainted casual-game background named 川西竹舍, a honey-golden rustic Sichuan bamboo teahouse, using the input images only as composition and rendering references. Exactly tall portrait aspect 720:1520 (equivalent to reference 863:1824), edge-to-edge image.
Input images: image 1 reference for high quality tactile stylized game illustration and empty play area; image 2 reference for scene layout. These are references, not art to copy literally.
Scene: Golden honey bamboo awning across upper 0-14% with bundled bamboo rods and finely woven warm straw textures. Dark jade narrow trim. Woven baskets, bamboo structural ribs and rustic red knotted hanging accents only along the extreme outer edges. Slender bamboo plants at far sides. Large very pale warm handmade paper/plaster empty playing surface extends through center. Bottom 26.5% is a golden rustic bamboo tabletop. A richly modeled black iron and copper hotpot full of spicy broth is partially cropped at bottom-left. Small woven basket and bamboo chopstick tube at bottom-right. Keep tabletop middle quiet and unobstructed.
Composition constraints: rigid composition matching references: decorated top 0-14%; LARGE EMPTY very evenly light center x10-90%, y16-73.5%; prop decorations restricted to narrow far-edge strips x0-9% and x91-100%; tabletop begins exactly y73.5%; all lower objects stay at outer bottom corners. Centre must look like a continuous pale playing surface and have no horizon, scenery, furniture, objects, motifs, visible food or strong shadows. Small delicate side shadows only. Top is richly dressed and lower corners visually rich.
Style and lighting: premium polished handpainted mobile game art, tactile woven fiber, cylindrical bamboo with nodes and clear joints, bamboo grain, 3D modeled volumes and warm amber bounce lighting, ornamental Chinese rural teahouse materials. Detailed but clean and legible, comparable rendering quality to reference. Visually distinct from green silk curtain scene: here the dominant material is honey bamboo and warm straw, with jade accents.
Absolute exclusions: NO TEXT or lettering or characters anywhere, NO logo, NO UI, NO buttons, NO tiles, NO food icons, NO phone or device frame, NO tray, NO menus, NO labels, NO center objects, NO flat vector look, NO photorealism, NO panel gutters. Only one background illustration.
